question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

His disease is no doubt very serious but he will __pull over.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **pull through**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given phrasal verbs.
 
 
• **Pull over** is a piece of clothing, made of warm material, that is worn on the top part of the body and put on by pulling it over your head. (कपड़े का एक टुकड़ा, गर्म सामग्री से बना है, जो शरीर के शीर्ष भाग पर पहना जाता है और इसे अपने सिर पर खींच कर रखा जाता है)
 
• **Pull through** means to get through an illness or other dangerous or difficult situation. (किसी बीमारी या अन्य खतरनाक या कठिन स्थिति से निकलने के लिए)
 
• **Pull for** means to say or show that one hopes for someone or something will succeed, get well, etc. (यह कहना या दिखाना कि कोई किसी के लिए आशा करता है या कुछ सफल होगा, ठीक हो जाओ)
 
• **Pull against** means to exert force on so as to remove; extract. (हटाने के लिए बल लगाना; निकालना)
 
• **Pull at** means to pull something quickly and usually repeatedly. (कुछ जल्दी और आमतौर पर बार-बार खींचने के लिए)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is: Although he has a very terrible illness, he will recover.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate option is "**pull through**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence:** *His disease is no doubt very serious but he will pull through__.*
